items.q: And we had a first trumpet player that was originally with the McKinney Cottonpickers.

ctx.x: He was quite a trumpet player. And we had a first trumpet player that was originally with the McKinney Cottonpickers. He was a professor. I was reading about him the other day. Right now his name skips me. (Langston Curl - <d.))
That's okay. We can dig that --
